# Resolving User Intent

## Core principle

Convert ambiguous product language into explicit goals, users, constraints, non-goals, success measures, and decision ownership. Activate only when the typed entry conditions are present; stop rather than inventing a missing tool, decision, or proof.

## When not to use

- a fully specified deterministic command
- minor wording preferences that do not affect behavior
